|                          |    | c In process 2, ethanol is oxidised to form ethanoic acid using potassium dichromate(VI).                                                       |                  |

|                          |    | d In process 3, ethanoic acid reacts with ethanol to form ethyl ethanoate in a condensation reaction.                                           |                  |
| SKILLS CRITICALTHINKING  |    | i Explain why this is called a condensation reaction.                                                                                           | (1)              |
|                          |    | ii How could you separate the product from the reaction mixture?                                                                                | (2)              |
